if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', target):
        raise ValueError('target must be a full commit SHA')
evidence.reason: The check at line 790 accepts any 40-character lowercase hex object ID. When `tag` is `None`, `verify_target` performs no `git cat-file -t` check, so an annotated tag object ID can pass. Git peels that tag object for `merge-base`, `ls-tree`, and config lookup, while checkout detaches at the peeled commit; the intent record and returned target can therefore identify the tag object rather than the commit at HEAD. Adding a `cat-file -t == commit` check before ancestry is the smallest compatible fix.
